main_text.l: RIO, viro doctorum ætatis iuæ Germa-

l.i: Ergo meos etiam laudas, Ioachime, libellos,
Et mea, quæ recitas, carmina digna putas:
O nimium natos felici sydere versus,
Quos tam facundo contigit ore canî! I
nunc, Mome, crepa. Nam quis, nisi pessimus,
illa Nunc odisse velit, quæ Ioachimus amet?
Et flammis & aquis crustacea numina fausta
Nec mirum. Hæc etenim crustacea numina cer-
Dira Trias, pictor, pistor, pastorque furente:
Ille Deos pingens, hic pinsens, cautor illis
Pastor, cui cibus est ille vtriusque labor:
Artibus haud parvis: aliis spectacula præbens,
Dans aliis præter parvula crusta nihil.
Quàm cautus, cui pro nihilo sic omnia cedunt! Quàm stulti huic dantes omnia pro nihilo!

page.notes: Left and right edges of the scan are clipped, so line ends are cut off (e.g. "fau-", "cer-", "numina ... pro nihilo"). Line-final words are reconstructed where the cut is partial; doubtful letters are unmarked because the lines are legible. The verse "Ergo meos" line ends are partly lost at the right edge. Handwritten annotations and marks in the margins are not transcribed.
